_comment: Category-pattern -> traffic-class map for ratan-qos. Patterns match the nDPI category strings emitted by flowtrack (e.g. 'VideoCall/Teams'). Pattern matching is simple prefix: 'VideoCall/' matches everything starting with VideoCall/.  The 'mark' field is the integer set in ct->mark and matched by nft.

classes.name: realtime
classes.description: Latency-critical real-time traffic (video calls, VoIP).  Strict-priority + guaranteed bandwidth floor.

classes.name: bulk
classes.description: Best-effort web / streaming / generic traffic.  Gets whatever bandwidth realtime isn't using.

classes.name: background
classes.description: Backups, OS updates, P2P -- gets only leftovers, ceiling capped.
